opening.argument: The upload title advertises a “SOLANA NFT MINTER BOT :fire: CRACKED BY OPENTEAM,” while the description directs viewers to a PROSNIPERBOT trial and paid license through the same download page. The footage instead discusses other NFT-bot products, including a “fully autonomous trading bot” and software that automatically bypasses transaction approval to make NFT launchpad sniping easier. Presenting that unrelated bot review alongside a separate download-and-purchase destination substitutes one product and destination for another. The deceptive element is therefore the product and destination mismatch, not proof that the reviewed NFT bots themselves are fraudulent.
